dimensions.name: AWAY_TEAM_ABBREVIATION
dimensions.comment: Short code of the away team.

dimensions.name: AWAY_TEAM_NAME
dimensions.comment: Full name of the away team.

dimensions.name: CONFERENCE
dimensions.comment: AFC or NFC of the away team.

dimensions.name: DIVISION
dimensions.comment: Division of the away team.

dimensions.name: TEAM_LOCATION
dimensions.comment: Away team city or region.

dimensions.name: GAME_DATE
dimensions.comment: Calendar date of the game.

dimensions.name: GAME_DATETIME
dimensions.comment: Full timestamp including kickoff time, in US EASTERN time (the league's publishing convention, matching the kickoff-time status strings). Same instant as the warehouse's UTC column, shifted for display; the offset in the value shows -0400 or -0500.

dimensions.name: GAME_STATUS
dimensions.comment: The source's own status label: 'Final' or 'Final/OT' for completed games; a kickoff-time string like '9/13 - 1:00 PM EDT' or 'TBD' for scheduled ones. Use is_completed to separate played from upcoming, never this string.

dimensions.name: IS_COMPLETED
dimensions.comment: True for played games, false for scheduled ones. This flag, not the date and not the status string, is the definition of upcoming.

dimensions.name: IS_POSTSEASON
dimensions.comment: True for playoff games.

dimensions.name: SEASON
dimensions.comment: NFL season, 2023 through 2026. A season's January and February games belong to the prior year's season. 2026 is the only season with unplayed games, so schedule questions mean 2026.

dimensions.name: SEASON_TYPE_NAME
dimensions.comment: Preseason, Regular Season, or Postseason. Schedule questions almost always mean Regular Season.

dimensions.name: VENUE
dimensions.comment: Stadium name as the source spells it. Every row has one; aliases such as GEHA Field at Arrowhead Stadium and Arrowhead Stadium are the same bowl.

dimensions.name: WEEK
dimensions.comment: Week within the season phase: 1-18 in the regular season. Week 1 exists in both preseason and regular season, so pair a week filter with the season phase.

dimensions.name: WENT_TO_OVERTIME
dimensions.comment: True for completed games that needed overtime. Always false on scheduled rows.

dimensions.name: CONFERENCE
dimensions.comment: AFC or NFC of the home team.

dimensions.name: DIVISION
dimensions.comment: Division of the home team. Uppercase in the data.

dimensions.name: HOME_TEAM_ABBREVIATION
dimensions.comment: Short code of the home team.

dimensions.name: HOME_TEAM_NAME
dimensions.comment: Full name of the home team.

dimensions.name: TEAM_LOCATION
dimensions.comment: Home team city or region, e.g. Kansas City, New York.

dimensions.name: ELEVATION_M
dimensions.comment: Stadium elevation in metres. Mile High is the regular-season home where this is the question.

dimensions.name: IS_INTERNATIONAL
dimensions.comment: True for games in London, Europe, Brazil, Mexico, Australia. False for Canton and regular-season homes.

dimensions.name: IS_WEATHER_RELEVANT
dimensions.comment: False for fixed roofs (SoFi, Ford Field, Allegiant, Superdome, U.S. Bank). When false, do not cite wind or temperature as affecting the game.

dimensions.name: ROOF
dimensions.comment: open, retractable, or fixed. Outdoors questions mean roof is open or retractable.

dimensions.name: STADIUM_DISPLAY_NAME
dimensions.comment: Canonical stadium name after alias collapse.

dimensions.name: SURFACE
dimensions.comment: grass or turf.

metrics.name: GAMES_COUNT
metrics.comment: Number of games. Grain is one row per GAME, not per team-game, so this counts games directly with no doubling.

metrics.name: REMAINING_GAMES
metrics.comment: Games still to be played. All of them are 2026 games.

facts.name: GUST_MPH
facts.comment: Forecast wind gusts at kickoff, mph.

facts.name: HOURS_BEFORE_KICKOFF
facts.comment: Hours between the forecast load and kickoff. Describes staleness, not a live radar.

facts.name: KICKOFF_TEMP_F
facts.comment: Forecast temperature at kickoff, Fahrenheit. Ignore when is_weather_relevant is false.

facts.name: PRECIP_IN
facts.comment: Forecast precipitation at the kickoff hour, inches.

facts.name: WIND_DIR_DEG
facts.comment: Forecast wind direction at kickoff, degrees from north.

facts.name: WIND_MPH
facts.comment: Forecast sustained wind at kickoff, mph. Ignore when is_weather_relevant is false.
